scripts.title: ChuxHub SaberShowdown ScriptV5
scripts.features:
Of course. Here is a list of every feature included in the ChuxHub script.

Saber Features
Auto Perfect Block: A smart auto-block that detects specific incoming attack animations from nearby enemies and automatically performs the correct directional block.

Auto-Engage Block: An automatic defense trigger. This feature forces your character to start blocking if you take damage or an enemy gets too close, so you don't have to manually hold the block button.

Saber Style Selector: A dropdown menu to choose your lightsaber combat style.

Reset Saber: A button to quickly unequip and re-equip your lightsaber, which can fix some common glitches.

Swing Speed Modifier: Allows you to increase or decrease the speed of your lightsaber swings and animations via a toggle and a textbox for a custom multiplier.

Kill Features
Teleport Kill Aura: When activated, this powerful feature automatically finds the closest enemy within a set range, instantly teleports you to them, and executes an attack. This requires the "Anti-Death" feature to be enabled first.

Adjustable Range: A textbox lets you define how far the Kill Aura will search for targets.

Other Features
Anti-Death: A core utility that enables the Kill Aura. It also functions as a constant auto-attack, repeatedly firing swing and attack commands.

Walk Speed Cycler: A button to instantly cycle your character's walk speed through several preset values (16, 20, 24).

Jump Power Cycler: A button to instantly cycle your character's jump power through several preset values (50, 60, 70).

GUI & Core Script Features
Draggable Interface: The main hub window can be clicked and dragged anywhere on your screen.

Full-Screen Loading Screen: An immersive loading screen with a progress bar when you first join.

UI Toggle: You can hide or show the entire GUI at any time by pressing the Right Shift key.

Scrolling Tabs: A clean, organized layout with clickable tabs for "Saber," "Kill," "Other," and "Credits."

Rainbow Text Effect: Many titles and buttons feature a dynamic, color-changing rainbow effect.

Credits Page: A dedicated tab crediting the creators of the hub.
